name: Samford Net / ISX
summary: Brisbane local ADSL/broadband + network consulting + hosting (ISX, 355 Samford Rd Enoggera, ~2002); defunct (ACN 117 784 817).

events.details: Defunct. The 2010-13 proposal relied on a zombie: the homepage still sold Samford dial-up in Jan 2006 but had become a computer shop by Apr 2007, so the ISP died c. 2006 (current c. 2005 is slightly early).

refs.label: 1 Jan 2006 entrance page still marketing Samford Internet dial-up/hosting - last ISP-facing homepage.
By 5 Apr 2007 the homepage was a computer shop/internet lounge - non-ISP activity, which does not extend ISP death.
One-word 'ISX' stub by Jul 2008; 403 by Apr 2017 - nothing ISP after 2006.
